> **0.5.9** is 0.5.8 packed under L'Cronx (plugin folder `L'Cronx - VST - LXRXXL`); nothing else changed. Uninstall 0.5.8 first.

LXRXXL for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
`LXRXXL-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin; `LXRXXL-<version>-source.zip` its complete source (required by the LXR02
Open-Source license: non-commercial use only).
See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.
